title: Dangote Cement aiming to list in London from November 2026
content: Nigeria/UK: Dangote Cement is preparing to list on the London Stock Exchange from November 2026. It has added Goldman Sachs Group and UBS Group as bookrunners, according sources contacted by Bloomberg. The cement company intends to raise around US$1bn by selling a 10% share in the group. title: UltraTech Cement grows sales and profits on increasing volumes
content: India: UltraTech Cement’s sales revenue rose by 17% year-on-year to US$5.05bn in the first half of its 2027 financial year from US$4.30bn a year earlier. Net profit increased by 19% to US$432m from US$364m. However, expenses – particular energy and logistics costs – grew by 17% to US$4.49bn from US$3.85bn. title: Mamba Cement to build grinding plant in Nairobi
content: Kenya: Mamba Cement plans to build a 180t/day grinding and blending plant in Awasi. The US$460,000 unit will market cement in the west of the country, according to the Business Daily newspaper. Rai Cement also operates a cement plant nearby.

title: Cherat Cement explores rail options
content: Pakistan: Cherat Cement has expressed interest in using Pakistan Railways’ Peshawar Division to transport coal and cement.
